title: Empty State
summary: A content-first empty-state composition that explains the current condition and presents a useful next action without decorative filler.

use_when: A view has no items or first-use content and the user needs orientation
A clear next action or recovery path exists
avoid_when: The absence is transient loading rather than an actual empty condition
The product has no meaningful next action to offer

accessibility: Keep the empty-state title in the document heading hierarchy.
Place the primary next action after the explanation in reading order.
Do not use illustration as the only explanation for why content is absent.
